entities.summary: The Sōtetsu Shin-Yokohama Line is a commuter line operated by Sotetsu between Nishiya Station on the Sōtetsu Main Line to Shin-Yokohama Station. Sōtetsu has put its company names as a formal part of the line names, which is a first for the company. Sōtetsu Shin-Yokohama Line is a railway line from Asia. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
